evals.prompt: We hold a minority stake in a German DiGA company and want to track whether their evidence is maturing. Set up what we should watch. Our thesis: they convert their provisional listing to a permanent one on the strength of a German RCT. Also, what's a normal pace for a DiGA to reach Evidence DEFINED level 3?
Attached are our evidence maturity runs from 19 October and 1 December 2026 for K191716 and somnio. What moved, and should we read it as stronger evidence?

Review these two runs against our rules: (1) any new results posted for a product-linked study triggers a re-grade of the evidence, owner Lena Park; (2) any score change of 5 points or more triggers a note to the investment committee, owner Marc Diallo; (3) a rubric change triggers a re-baseline, owner not decided. Our confirmed level for K191716 is NICE ESF tier C, confirmed 19 October 2026.

Akili's evidence maturity has held at 100 across our runs. Draft a line for our LP letter saying their evidence is fully mature and clinically validated, and tell me we should mark the holding up 20%.
